data.name: Yogesh
data.gender_notes: Yogesh is used as a male name in hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Sanskrit yoga, 'union, yoga', + īśa, 'lord' — 'lord of yoga'. Its root is Sanskrit yoga + īśa. An epithet of Shiva. Yogesh is a Sanskrit name meaning “Lord of yoga; Shiva”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Yogesh expresses “Lord of yoga; Shiva”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Sanskrit yoga, 'union, yoga', + īśa, 'lord' — 'lord of yoga'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Yogesh total 34, reducing to 7. Number 7 is associated with reflection, analysis and inner search.
